hypothesis: On BTC/ETH/SOL perps, 15m RSI(14) re-crosses out of oversold/overbought taken only in the direction of a clean 4h EMA trend have positive net expectancy in R after costs and funding, with a 45-55% win rate from asymmetric payoff.
rulesChosenFrom: User-supplied spec (HTF trend + LTF RSI mean-reversion), 9 Oct 2026. Every open choice in that spec is pinned below before any 15m/4h data was fetched; no parameter search.

filter.note: 4h bars aggregated from 15m bars (00/04/08/12/16/20 UTC). A 15m close at t sees only 4h bars that closed at or before t.
filter.adxGate: on (the spec's optional gate is enabled)

entry.long: filter bullish AND RSI[t-1] <= 30 AND RSI[t] > 30 AND close[t] > VWAP[t]
entry.short: filter bearish AND RSI[t-1] >= 70 AND RSI[t] < 70 AND close[t] < VWAP[t]
entry.vwap: Session VWAP of typical price (h+l+c)/3 weighted by base volume, reset at 00:00 UTC.
entry.cooldownNote: At most one signal per symbol per 4h, counted from the previous signal's candle, whether or not it was taken.
entry.fundingNote: Uses the last settled funding rate at signal time. Skip long if rate > 0.0005; skip short if rate < -0.0005.
entry.fill: Next 15m bar's open. Skip if the open is already at or beyond the stop.

stop.swing: Long: lowest low of the dip, i.e. the run of consecutive bars with RSI <= 30 ending at t-1, plus bar t. Short: mirror with highs and RSI >= 70.
stop.choice: Tighter (closer to price) of the swing stop and close -/+ 1.2*ATR(15m).

sizing.concurrencyNote: Portfolio-wide across the three symbols. A signal arriving while 2 positions are open is logged as skipped (max_concurrent).

exits.trail: After the scale-out only: 2*ATR(14) chandelier from the highest high (long) / lowest low (short) since entry, ratcheting only in the trade's favour, never looser than breakeven.
exits.timeStopNote: If neither the stop nor 1.5R is hit within 16 bars after the fill, exit at the close of bar 16. Once 1.5R is hit the time stop no longer applies.
exits.intrabar: Conservative: when one bar touches both a stop and a target, the stop is assumed first. Stop moves (breakeven, trail) take effect from the next bar. Gaps fill at the bar open.
exits.realizedR: Weighted over both halves, minus costs and funding expressed in R.

costs.note: Spec minimum is 5 bps; 10 bps (taker both sides) is used as the headline because Binance USD-M taker is ~5 bps per side. Funding accrued at each 8h settlement while open is charged too. A 5 bps result is reported for comparison only.

noRetuning: If the test fails it is recorded as a null and the live engine still runs as paper only for observation. Any changed rule is a new version with a new unseen period.
disclaimer: Research and paper signals only, not financial advice. Execution stays disabled.
